import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Extract hour from time column
df['hour'] = df['time'].str.split(':').str[0].astype(int)

# Aggregate total sales by hour
hourly_sales = df.groupby('hour')['total'].sum().reset_index()

# Create the visualization
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
plt.bar(hourly_sales['hour'], hourly_sales['total'], color='skyblue', edgecolor='black')
plt.xlabel('Hour of the Day')
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
plt.title('Total Sales by Hour of the Day')
plt.xticks(range(0, 24))
plt.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Extract hour from time column
df['hour'] = df['time'].str.split(':').str[0].astype(int)

# Aggregate total sales by hour
hourly_sales = df.groupby('hour')['total'].sum().reset_index()

# Create the visualization
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
plt.bar(hourly_sales['hour'], hourly_sales['total'], color='skyblue', edgecolor='black')
plt.xlabel('Hour of the Day')
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
plt.title('Total Sales by Hour of the Day')
plt.xticks(range(0, 24))
plt.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
